title: Bioactive compound schaftoside from Clinacanthus nutans attenuates acute liver injury by inhibiting ferroptosis through activation the Nrf2/GPX4 pathway.
authors: Yu, Yi; Liang, Jingwei; Yuan, Zhexin; Wang, Aiping; Liu, Xinxing; Chen, Yu; Zhang, Min; Gao, Yanan; Zhang, Haiying; Liu, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物schaftoside通过Nrf2/GPX4通路抑制铁死亡治疗急性肝损伤，仅用分子对接验证小分子与蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Clinacanthus nutans (Burm. f.) Lindau, a traditional herb renowned for its anti-tumor, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, has garnered considerable attention. Although its hepatoprotective effects have been described, there is still limited knowledge of its treatment of acute liver injury (ALI), and its mechanisms remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: To assess the efficacy of Clinacanthus nutans in ALI and to identify the most effective fractions and their underlying mechanism of action. METHODS: Bioinformatics was employed to explore the underlying anti-hepatic injury mechanisms and active compounds of Clinacanthus nutans. The binding ability of schaftoside, a potential active ingredient in Clinacanthus nutans, to the core target nuclear factor E2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) was further determined by molecular docking. The role of schaftoside in improving histological abnormalities in the liver was observed by H&E and Masson's staining in an ALI model induced by CCl(4). Serum and liver biochemical parameters were measured using AST, ALT and hydroxyproline kits. An Fe(2+) kit, transmission electron microscopy, western blotting, RT-qPCR, and DCFH-DA were used to measure whether schaftoside reduces ferroptosis-induced ALI. Subsequently, specific siRNA knockdown of Nrf2 in AML12 cells was performed to further elucidate the mechanism by which schaftoside attenuates ferroptosis-induced ALI. RESULTS: Bioinformatics analysis and molecular docking showed that schaftoside is the principal compound from Clinacanthus nutans. Schaftoside was shown to diminish oxidative stress levels, attenuate liver fibrosis, and forestall ferroptosis. Deeper investigations revealed that schaftoside amplified Nrf2 expression and triggered the Nrf2/GPX4 pathway, thereby reversing mitochondrial aberrations triggered by lipid peroxidation, GPX4 depletion, and ferroptosis. CONCLUSION: The lead compound schaftoside counters ferroptosis through the Nrf2/GPX4 axis, providing insights into a novel molecular mechanism for treating ALI, thereby presenting an innovative therapeutic strategy for ferroptosis-induced ALI.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：鳄嘴花（Clinacanthus nutans (Burm. f.) Lindau）是一种传统草药，以其抗肿瘤、抗氧化和抗炎特性而闻名，已引起广泛关注。尽管其保肝作用已有描述，但其对急性肝损伤（ALI）的治疗作用仍知之甚少，且其机制尚不明确。研究目的：评估鳄嘴花在急性肝损伤中的疗效，并确定最有效的活性部位及其作用机制。方法：采用生物信息学方法探讨鳄嘴花潜在的抗肝损伤机制及活性化合物。通过分子对接进一步测定鳄嘴花中潜在活性成分夏佛塔苷（schaftoside）与核心靶点核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）的结合能力。在CCl(4)诱导的急性肝损伤模型中，通过H&E和Masson染色观察夏佛塔苷改善肝脏组织学异常的作用。使用AST、ALT和羟脯氨酸试剂盒测定血清和肝脏生化参数。采用Fe(2+)试剂盒、透射电子显微镜、western blotting、RT-qPCR和DCFH-DA检测夏佛塔苷是否减少铁死亡诱导的急性肝损伤。随后，在AML12细胞中进行Nrf2特异性siRNA敲低，以进一步阐明夏佛塔苷减轻铁死亡诱导急性肝损伤的机制。结果：生物信息学分析和分子对接表明，夏佛塔苷是鳄嘴花中的主要化合物。夏佛塔苷被证明可降低氧化应激水平、减轻肝纤维化并阻止铁死亡。进一步研究表明，夏佛塔苷增强Nrf2表达并触发Nrf2/GPX4通路，从而逆转由脂质过氧化、GPX4耗竭和铁死亡引起的线粒体异常。结论：先导化合物夏佛塔苷通过Nrf2/GPX4轴对抗铁死亡，为治疗急性肝损伤提供了新的分子机制见解，从而为铁死亡诱导的急性肝损伤提出了一种创新性治疗策略。
